sections.text_helper: Section 47.6.2 "Validation conditions" in chapter 47 (True random number generator (RNG)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2296.
sections.section_content:
STMicroelectronics has tested the RNG true random number generator in the following
conditions:
• RNG clock rng_clk = 64MHz, with CED bit cleared in RNG_CR
• RNG configurations are described in Table398. Note that only configuration A can be
certified NIST SP800-90B. Refer to Table399 to select the best configuration for the
application.
• Configuration C can be used when configuration A is not flagged as certified.
[Table 398. RNG configurations]
[Table 399. Configuration selection]
For details on data collection and the running of statistical test suites refer to AN4230
“STM32 microcontrollers random number generation validation using NIST statistical test
suite” available from www.st.com.
